related_sources.source_text:
🚨 Gemini 4 Carbon vs Kimi K3.1, after my first tests I feel like both models could easily compete with Opus 5.5 Medium when it comes to 3D, and I'm really liking what I'm seeing from both of them! The quality is impressive and they're both very fast, but I think Kimi K3.1 is going to surprise a lot of people, myself included. If they manage to release it at prices similar to DeepSeek, it could be game over for a lot of closed source coding models from US labs, especially when you consider how good the quality already looks in these early tests.

Now I'm just hoping they finally release the model along with its open weights so we can run a quantized version locally! I can't wait to see how it performs outside Arena and how much we can push it with more demanding projects. What a great week we have ahead of us!

cases.source_text:
Kimi K3.1 Kibitz is now confirmed to be a very affordable model, similar to GLM 5.3, I just got this new test on Arena and so far my results have been pretty mixed, in some tests Kibitz performs at the level of GPT 6 Astra Medium or Opus 5.5 Medium, while in others the quality drops quite a bit. But considering how good some of these results are and how affordable the model is expected to be, I'm really looking forward to seeing what Kimi has been working on these past few months

My prediction is that Kimi K3.1 could become the best open weight AI model we've seen so far, and if it really delivers this level of performance at such a low price, it could put some serious pressure on Zhipu's upcoming GLM 5.4 and GLM 5.5 models, which are expected next month. The competition between these Chinese AI labs is getting more interesting with every release, and the best part is that we're the ones who benefit from all of this, getting better models, faster performance and lower prices

cases.takeaway: Compare a small mechanical house with Fable's result.
cases.body_notes: The creator compares Kibitz with Fable 5.1 and reports faster generation in this test. The broader quality ranking is subjective.
cases.prompt_boundary: Usecase collection; full source text retained externally; no reconstructed prompts.
cases.source_text: Kibitz (Kimi K3.1) vs Fable 5.1 on Arena, and I'm really impressed with what I'm seeing in this test! I'm guessing the new Kimi model might be using its highest reasoning setting by default because that's the only explanation I can think of for how good the 3D quality looks throughout the entire video. I'd actually put it pretty close to Opus 5.5 Medium, which is a huge achievement considering how good that model already is at 3D. Kimi models have always been pretty expensive, so I'm really hoping this one can be as efficient and affordable as DeepSeek, because if they manage to deliver this level of quality at a similar price, we could be looking at the best open weight AI model of the year. The Kimi team has done an amazing job here, and another thing worth mentioning is that Kibitz was noticeably faster than Fable in this particular test! I can't wait to see how it performs in my other comparisons.

Arena 测试中的新模型 Kibitz 疑似 为 Kimi K3.1

今天（10/22）凌晨在 Arena 出现两个新模型，Kibitz 和 Kalmia
